newsitem.title: USA: Paccar names Mark Pigott chairman and CEO.
newsitem.headline: Paccar names Mark Pigott chairman and CEO.

text.p: PACCAR Inc said on Tuesday its board of directors elected Mark Pigott to the posts of chairman and chief executive, effective January 1, 1997.
Pigott replaces his father Charles Pigott, who will remain on the company's board.
Mark Pigott joined PACCAR in 1978, and has held several positions in manufacturing and general management with the company's Peterbilt and Foden truck divisions.
Mark Pigott most recently served as vice chairman with responsibility for Kenworth Truck Co., Peterbilt Motors, Foden Trucks, the PACCAR Technical Center and PACCAR International.
